## Context / Problem
The tests/scripts cohort contains 53 editable prose blocks across the 18 recorded file-impact paths. The retired audit listed 39; the current immutable-basis census adds 14 post-audit blocks in dependency-audit and observability tests. Condense only current ordinary prose while preserving every behavioral oracle and runtime payload.

The prose inventory and immutable before-citations are pinned to origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e. At plan repair time origin/main had advanced to 10533b1e3f651a60e8cea5691318c108ff1f3396 only through unrelated workflow/grounding files; none of this ticket's scoped blobs changed after 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e. Implement from current origin/main, but keep 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e as the immutable prose-audit basis. The final leaf change is one commit, so changed-path checks use HEAD^..HEAD rather than the audit-base aggregate.

## Approach
Edit only ordinary comments and docstrings at the stable module, symbol, or prose-first-line anchors below. Do not edit executable statements, assertions, directives, runtime strings, shell snippets embedded in Python, or unlisted prose.

For every Python path, parse base and final source with ast.parse(source, type_comments=True). Recursively remove only the leading Expr(Constant(str)) from bodies of Module, ClassDef, FunctionDef, and AsyncFunctionDef; normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno; then require exact ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False) equality. This retains every non-docstring runtime string, including _stub(...) payloads. Separately compare directives because comments are absent from the AST.

A non-author reviewer must post exactly 53 leaf-linked TSV rows:
path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session
Before and after citations use full immutable commit SHAs. Both verdict columns must be PASS; missing rows block closure.

## Scope — 53 editable blocks
- test_check_config_reads_red_proof.py — module docstring; scoped prose in old_gate; docstrings of test_the_pre_fix_gate_silently_passes_the_inert_field and test_a_uniquely_named_inert_field_fired_on_BOTH_versions. Preserve the live-versus-prefixed differential and unique-name control.
- test_check_config_reads.py — module docstring and test_same_named_field_on_an_unrelated_config_does_not_satisfy_it docstring. Preserve owner-resolved reads, marker semantics, and the name-collision regression.
- test_check_import_walk.py — module docstring and test_sibling_insert_cannot_mask_the_missing_one docstring. Preserve fresh-process isolation and scripts/provider import coverage.
- test_check_orphaned_load.py — module docstring and scoped prose following test_real_adapter_reads_live_process_table_without_raising. Preserve the read-only guarantee, PID-1/high-CPU detection, and system-daemon exclusion.
- test_cli_seam_clean_heldout.py — module docstring. Preserve the observable zero-exception seam-clean contract.
- test_dependency_audit.py — module docstring; scoped prose around test_gate_gerrit_fails_closed_when_the_diff_is_unresolvable, test_a_real_finding_is_not_retried, and test_advisory_alert_close_argv_survives_the_real_transition_parser; comment beginning "A missing audit verdict is NOT an all-clear…"; and docstrings of test_only_an_explicit_false_verdict_may_close_the_advisory_ticket, test_a_missing_verdict_writes_nothing_at_all, test_a_crashed_audit_is_distinguishable_from_a_genuine_all_clear, and test_a_missing_verdict_is_still_silent_under_dry_run. Preserve lane routing, logical retry scheduling, real-parser validation, tri-state BLOCKING semantics, and no-write refusal when a verdict is absent.
- test_llm_seam_clean_heldout.py — module docstring. Preserve seam-clean and live-per-call behavior.
- test_mcp_client_pats.py — module docstring. Preserve per-client PAT separation, SSM materialization, fail-closed behavior, and nondisclosure.
- test_mcp_server_seam_clean_heldout.py — module docstring and module comment immediately before _mcp_gate_findings. Preserve zero below-seam reads and provider-boundary exceptions.
- test_mutation_sandbox.py — module docstring; scoped prose within test_a_mechanism_is_required_when_the_lane_says_so, test_the_incident_shape_rm_rf_is_denied, and test_seatbelt_present_but_not_enforcing_is_not_offered; comment before test_ambient_ci_does_not_waive_the_sandbox; test_the_sandboxed_subprocesses_receive_the_hardened_env docstring; and comment before _is_mutmut_run. Preserve destructive-test containment, positive child-liveness proof, capability-over-presence probes, hardened child environment, and whole-module call-site binding.
- test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py — module docstring. Preserve its two-input normalization and closed output domain.
- test_observability_coldstart_e2a6.py — module docstring; _environment cursor-state comment; _state docstring; and seed comment in test_cold_start_publishes_zero_and_seeds_the_offset. Preserve publish-before-persist, cursor state, and the bare-total replication-log exception.
- test_observability_data_disk_debris.py — module docstring. Preserve non-site debris census, real du execution, bounded dimension, and refusal to fabricate zero on an unobservable volume.
- test_observability_disk_pressure.py — module docstring; _environment cursor-format comment; _state_total docstring; test_real_markers_are_counted_alongside_the_prose docstring; and test_no_persistence_markers_publishes_zero docstring. Preserve record-anchored counting, ineffective-reclaim persistence, and the separate scratch-volume mount signal.
- test_observability_exit.py — module docstring. Preserve the aggregate probe's exit-zero contract while individual failures remain observable.
- test_observability_marker_anchor_8c2f.py — module docstring; _environment cursor-format comment; test_offsets_inflated_by_false_counts_cannot_distort_a_delta docstring; and its inline inflated-total comment. Preserve cursor-based immunity to inflated legacy totals, not the obsolete "lost-history clamp" description.
- test_observability_mcp_health_9ea3.py — module docstring plus docstrings of test_an_unhealthy_serving_path_publishes_zero_not_nothing and test_upstream_lost_mid_gate_latches_a_sustained_zero. Preserve 401-as-healthy semantics, explicit bad-path zero, and the gate-independent serving-path probe.
- test_observability_mcp_markers.py — module docstring; _environment cursor-format comment; and cold-start seed comment in test_cold_start_seeds_offsets_and_publishes_zero. Preserve distinct retire-cap and memory-abort counters.

The 14 additions over the retired 39-block inventory are: five blocks in test_dependency_audit.py, three in test_observability_coldstart_e2a6.py, two in test_observability_disk_pressure.py, two in test_observability_marker_anchor_8c2f.py, and two in test_observability_mcp_markers.py.

## Consumers and runtime exclusions
Pytest executes all 18 modules. scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py is the deterministic prose-policy consumer. No targeted __doc__, inspect.getdoc, or doctest consumer was found.

The observability tests import tests/scripts/_journald_stub.py, but it is outside the parent retired-ticket boundary and must not be added to file impact. Its JOURNALCTL_EMULATOR and TIMEOUT_STUB strings are runtime content. All _stub(...) multiline payloads in scoped files are also runtime content and must remain AST-identical. No directive comments were found in this 18-path set; the directive guard must remain empty-to-empty and therefore also detects introduced directives.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the 53 allowlisted prose blocks or adjacent blank lines change.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints.
- [ ] Normalized Python ASTs are exactly equal between 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e and the final commit.
- [ ] No directive is introduced, removed, or moved; all runtime stub and heredoc-like strings remain AST-identical.
- [ ] Sorted paths changed by the single leaf commit HEAD^..HEAD exactly equal the 18 recorded file-impact paths; _journald_stub.py remains outside the diff.
- [ ] The non-author TSV contains exactly 53 passing rows with full before/final SHAs.
- [ ] The semantic, directive, path-set, diff, hygiene, focused-test, and full-repository commands recorded under Verification pass.

## Verification
Run every structured verify command. The AST and empty-to-empty directive comparators are the executable semantic guards; the independent 53-row TSV is authoritative for prose quality. The focused command executes every scoped test file, including the added dependency-audit nodes and renamed observability marker test.
